40019828.author: पदार्थः
40019828.content: प्राप्तराज्यस्य of one who has attained the kingdom, रामस्य of Rama, राक्षसानां of the Rakshasas (demons), वधे upon the destruction, कृते having been accomplished, आजग्मुः came, ऋषयः sages, सर्वे all, राघवं to Raghava (Rama), प्रतिनन्दितुम् to congratulate

40019828.author: Translation
40019828.content: After Rama had attained his kingdom and the destruction of the Rakshasas was accomplished, all the sages came to congratulate Raghava.

40019829.author: पदार्थः
40019829.content: कौशिको Kaushika (Vishwamitra), अथ and, यवक्रीतो Yavakrita, गार्ग्यो Gargya, गालव Galava, एव च and also, कण्वो Kanva, मेधातिथेः of Medhatithi, पुत्रः the son, पूर्वस्यां in the eastern, दिशि direction, ये who, श्रिताः resided

40019829.author: Translation
40019829.content: Kaushika, Yavakrita, Gargya, Galava, and Kanva, the son of Medhatithi, who resided in the eastern direction, also arrived.

40019830.author: पदार्थः
40019830.content: स्वस्त्यात्रेयो Svastyatreya, अथ and, भगवान् the revered, नमुचिः Namuchi, प्रमुचिस्तथा and Pramuchi, आजग्मुस्ते they came, सहागस्त्या with Agastya, ये who, श्रिता resided, दक्षिणां in the southern, दिशम् direction

40019830.author: Translation
40019830.content: Svastyatreya, the revered Namuchi, and Pramuchi, along with Agastya, who resided in the southern direction, also came.

40019831.author: पदार्थः
40019831.content: नृषद्गुः Nṛṣadgu, कवषो Kavaṣa, धौम्यो Dhaumya, रौद्रेयश्च and Raudreya, महानृषिः the great sage, ते they, अपि also, आजग्मुः came, सशिष्या with their disciples, वै indeed, ये who, श्रिताः resided, पश्चिमां in the western, दिशम् direction

40019831.author: Translation
40019831.content: Nṛṣadgu, Kavaṣa, Dhaumya, and the great sage Raudreya, who resided in the western direction, also came with their disciples.

40019832.author: पदार्थः
40019832.content: वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, कश्यपो Kashyapa, अथ and, अत्रिर् Atri, विश्वामित्रः Vishwamitra, सगौतमः with Gautama, जमदग्निर्भरद्वाजस् Jamadagni and Bharadvaja, ते they, अपि also, सप्तर्षयस्तथा and the Saptarshis (seven sages)

40019832.author: Translation
40019832.content: Vasishtha, Kashyapa, Atri, Vishwamitra with Gautama, Jamadagni, and Bharadvaja, who are also known as the Saptarshis, were among those who arrived.

40019833.author: पदार्थः
40019833.content: उदीच्यां in the northern, दिशि direction, सप्तैते these seven, नित्यमेव always indeed, निवासिनः residents

40019833.author: Translation
40019833.content: These seven sages are permanent residents in the northern direction.

40019834.author: पदार्थः
40019834.content: सम्प्राप्य having reached, ते those, महात्मानो great souls, राघवस्य of Rama, निवेशनम् abode, विष्टिताः stood, प्रतिहारार्थं for the purpose of guarding the gate, हुताशनसमप्रभाः having a luster like fire, वेदवेदाङ्गविदुषो knowing the Vedas and Vedangas, नानाशास्त्रविशारदाः skilled in various scriptures

40019834.author: Translation
40019834.content: Having arrived at Rama's palace, those great souls, shining like fire, knowledgeable in the Vedas, Vedangas, and various scriptures, stood at the gate as guards.

40019835.author: पदार्थः
40019835.content: द्वाःस्थं to the doorkeeper, प्रोवाच spoke, धर्मात्मा the righteous-souled, अगस्त्यो Agastya, मुनिसत्तमः the best among sages, निवेद्यतां let it be announced, दाशरथेः to Dasharatha's son (Rama), ऋषीन् us sages, अस्मान् who, समागतान् have arrived

40019835.author: Translation
40019835.content: The righteous Agastya, the best of sages, spoke to the doorkeeper, instructing him to announce their arrival to Rama, the son of Dasharatha.

40019836.author: पदार्थः
40019836.content: प्रतीहारः the doorkeeper, ततः then, तूर्णम् quickly, अगस्त्य of Agastya, वचनात् from the words, द्रुतम् swiftly, समीपम् to the presence, राघवस्य of Rama, आशु quickly, प्रविवेश entered, महात्मनः of the great-souled one

40019836.author: Translation
40019836.content: Then, the doorkeeper, swiftly and quickly, entered the presence of the great-souled Rama, following Agastya's words.

40019837.author: पदार्थः
40019837.content: नयेङ्गितज्ञः knowing policy and gestures, सद्वृत्तः of good conduct, दक्षः skillful, धैर्यसमन्वितः endowed with courage, सः he, रामम् Rama, दृश्य having seen, सहसा suddenly, पूर्णचन्द्रसमप्रभम् having a luster like the full moon

40019837.author: Translation
40019837.content: He, who was skilled in policy and gestures, of good conduct, efficient, and endowed with courage, immediately saw Rama, who shone like the full moon.

40019838.author: पदार्थः
40019838.content: अगस्त्यम् Agastya, कथयामास told, सम्प्राप्तम् arrived, ऋषिभिः with sages, सह with

40019838.author: Translation
40019838.content: He informed (Rama) that Agastya had arrived along with other sages.

40019839.author: पदार्थः
40019839.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, प्राप्तान् arrived, मुनींस्तांस्तु those sages, बालसूर्यसमप्रभान् having the radiance equal to the morning sun, प्रत्युवाच replied, ततो then, द्वास्स्थम् to the doorkeeper, प्रवेशय let them enter, यथासुखम् comfortably

40019839.author: Translation
40019839.content: Having heard that those sages, radiant like the morning sun, had arrived, Rama then replied to the doorkeeper, instructing him to admit them comfortably.

40019840.author: पदार्थः
40019840.content: तान् those, सम्प्राप्तान् arrived, मुनीन् sages, दृष्ट्वा having seen, प्रत्युत्थाय having risen to greet, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, पाद्यार्घ्यादिभिः with water for feet and other offerings, आनर्च worshipped, गाम् a cow, निवेद्य having offered, च and, सादरम् respectfully

40019840.author: Translation
40019840.content: Having seen those arrived sages, Rama rose to greet them with folded hands, honored them with water for their feet and other offerings, and respectfully presented a cow.

40019841.author: पदार्थः
40019841.content: रामः Rama, अभिवाद्य having saluted, प्रयत attentive, आसनानि seats, आदिदेश ordered, ह indeed, तेषु on those, काञ्चनचित्रेषु adorned with gold, महत्सु great, च and, वरेषु excellent, च and

40019841.author: Translation
40019841.content: Rama, having saluted them with a composed mind, indeed offered them seats that were great, excellent, and adorned with gold.

40019842.author: पदार्थः
40019842.content: कुशान्तर्धानदत्तेषु provided with kusha grass underneath, मृगचर्मयुतेषु furnished with deer skins, च and, यथार्हम् appropriately, उपविष्टाः sat, ते they, आसनेषु on the seats, ऋषिपुङ्गवाः the foremost among sages

40019842.author: Translation
40019842.content: The foremost among sages then sat appropriately on those seats, which were provided with kusha grass underneath and furnished with deer skins.

40019843.author: पदार्थः
40019843.content: रामेण by Rama, कुशलं welfare, पृष्टाः asked, सशिष्याः with their disciples, सपुरोगमाः with their prominent members, महर्षयः the great sages, वेदविदः knowers of the Vedas, रामं to Rama, वचनम् words, अब्रुवन् spoke.

40019843.author: Translation
40019843.content: When Rama inquired about their well-being, the great sages, who were knowers of the Vedas and accompanied by their disciples and prominent members, spoke these words to him.

40019844.author: पदार्थः
40019844.content: कुशलं well-being, नः our, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, सर्वत्र everywhere, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghu dynasty, त्वां you, तु but, दिष्ट्या fortunately, कुशलिनं well, पश्यामो we see, हतशात्रवम् with enemies slain.

40019844.author: Translation
40019844.content: The sages replied that they were well everywhere, O mighty-armed Rama, and they were fortunate to see him safe and with his enemies slain.

40019845.author: पदार्थः
40019845.content: दिष्ट्या fortunately, त्वया by you, हतः slain, राजन् O King, रावणः Ravana, लोकरावणः who made the worlds weep, न not, हि indeed, भारः a burden, सः that, ते to you, राम O Rama, रावणः Ravana, पुत्रपौत्रवान् with sons and grandsons.

40019845.author: Translation
40019845.content: O King, it is fortunate that you have slain Ravana, who tormented the worlds, for indeed, even with his sons and grandsons, he was no match for you, O Rama.

40019846.author: पदार्थः
40019846.content: सधनुः with your bow, त्वं you, हि indeed, लोकान् worlds, त्रीन् three, विजयेथा would conquer, न no, संशयः doubt, दिष्ट्या fortunately, त्वया by you, हतः slain, राम O Rama, रावणः Ravana, राक्षसेश्वरः the lord of Rakshasas.

40019846.author: Translation
40019846.content: There is no doubt that you, with your bow, could indeed conquer the three worlds, and it is fortunate, O Rama, that you have slain Ravana, the lord of the Rakshasas.

40019847.author: पदार्थः
40019847.content: दिष्ट्या fortunately, विजयिनं victorious, त्वा you, अद्य today, पश्यामः we see, सह with, सीतया Sita, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, च and, धर्मात्मन् O righteous one, भ्रात्रा by brother, त्वद्धितकारिणा who acts for your welfare.

40019847.author: Translation
40019847.content: O righteous one, it is fortunate that today we see you victorious, accompanied by Sita and by Lakshmana, your brother who always acts for your welfare.

40019848.author: पदार्थः
40019848.content: मातृभिः with mothers, भ्रातृसहितम् together with brothers, पश्यामः we see, अद्य today, वयम् we, नृप O King, दिष्ट्या fortunately, प्रहस्तः Prahasta, विकटः Vikata, विरूपाक्षः Virupaksha, महोदरः Mahodara, अकम्पनः Akampana, च and, दुर्धर्षः Durdharsha, निहताः killed, ते those, निशाचराः demons.

40019848.author: Translation
40019848.content: O King, we are fortunate to see you today with our mothers and brothers, and it is by good fortune that those demons Prahasta, Vikata, Virupaksha, Mahodara, Akampana, and Durdharsha have been killed.

40019849.author: पदार्थः
40019849.content: यस्य whose, प्रमाणात् than the measure, विपुलम् greater, प्रमाणम् measure, न not, इह here, विद्यते exists, दिष्ट्या fortunately, ते by you, समरे in battle, राम O Rama, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, निपातितः struck down.

40019849.author: Translation
40019849.content: O Rama, it is by good fortune that you have struck down Kumbhakarna in battle, whose immense size has no equal in this world.

40019850.author: पदार्थः
40019850.content: त्रिशिराः Trishira, च and, अतिकायः Atikaya, च and, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devantaka and Narantaka, दिष्ट्या fortunately, ते by you, निहताः killed, राम O Rama, महावीर्याः very powerful, निशाचराः demons.

40019850.author: Translation
40019850.content: O Rama, it is by good fortune that you have killed those extremely powerful demons Trishira, Atikaya, Devantaka, and Narantaka.

40019851.author: पदार्थः
40019851.content: कुम्भः Kumbha, च and, एव indeed, निकुम्भः Nikumbha, च and, राक्षसौ two demons, भीमदर्शनौ of terrible appearance, दिष्ट्या fortunately, तौ those two, निहतौ killed, राम O Rama, कुम्भकर्णसुतौ sons of Kumbhakarna, मृधे in battle.

40019851.author: Translation
40019851.content: O Rama, it is by good fortune that you have killed Kumbha and Nikumbha, the two sons of Kumbhakarna who were of terrible appearance, in battle.

40019852.author: पदार्थः
40019852.content: युद्धोन्मत्तः Yuddhonmatta, च and, मत्तः Matta, च and, कालान्तकयमोपमौ like Kala and Yama, यज्ञकोपः Yajnakopa, च and, बलवान् powerful, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, नाम named, राक्षसः demon.

40019852.author: Translation
40019852.content: This shloka continues the list of formidable demons, including Yuddhonmatta and Matta who were like Kala and Yama, along with Yajnakopa and the powerful demon named Dhumraksha, whose defeat is being celebrated.

40019853.author: पदार्थः
40019853.content: कुर्वन्तः doing, कदनं slaughter, घोरम् terrible, एते these, शस्त्रास्त्रपारगाः masters of weapons and missiles, अन्तकप्रतिमैः resembling Yama, बाणैः with arrows, दिष्ट्या fortunately, विनिहताः killed, त्वया by you.

40019853.author: Translation
40019853.content: Fortunately, these masters of weapons and missiles, who were causing terrible slaughter, have been killed by you with arrows resembling those of Yama.

40019854.author: पदार्थः
40019854.content: दिष्ट्या fortunately, त्वं you, राक्षसेन्द्रेण with the king of Rakshasas, द्वन्द्वयुद्धम् a duel, उपागतः engaged in, देवतानाम् for the gods, अवध्येन by the invincible one, विजयं victory, प्राप्तवानसि you have obtained.

40019854.author: Translation
40019854.content: Fortunately, you engaged in a duel with the king of Rakshasas, who was invincible even to the gods, and you have achieved victory.

40019855.author: पदार्थः
40019855.content: सङ्ख्ये in battle, तस्य his, न not, किञ्चित् any, तु but, रावणस्य of Ravana, पराभवः defeat, द्वन्द्वयुद्धम् a duel, अनुप्राप्तः engaged in, दिष्ट्या fortunately, ते by you, रावणिः Ravana's son, हतः killed.

40019855.author: Translation
40019855.content: There was no defeat for Ravana in battle, but fortunately, having engaged in a duel, Ravana's son (Indrajit) has been killed by you.

40019856.author: पदार्थः
40019856.content: दिष्ट्या fortunately, तस्य from him, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, कालस्य of death, इव like, अभिधावतः rushing, मुक्तः freed, सुररिपोः from the enemy of gods, वीर O hero, प्राप्तः obtained, च and, विजयः victory, त्वया by you.

40019856.author: Translation
40019856.content: O mighty-armed hero, fortunately, you have been freed from that enemy of the gods who was rushing like death itself, and victory has been achieved by you.

40019857.author: पदार्थः
40019857.content: अभिनन्दाम we congratulate, ते you, सर्वे all, संश्रुत्य having heard, इन्द्रजितः of Indrajit, वधम् the killing, सः he, अवध्यः invincible, सर्वभूतानाम् by all beings, महामायाधरः master of great illusion, युधि in battle.

40019857.author: Translation
40019857.content: All of us congratulate you upon hearing of Indrajit's death, for he was invincible to all beings and a master of great illusion in battle.

40019858.author: पदार्थः
40019858.content: विस्मयः wonder, तु indeed, एषः this, च and, अस्माकम् our, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, इन्द्रजितम् Indrajit, हतम् killed.

40019858.author: Translation
40019858.content: This is indeed our great wonder, having heard that Indrajit was killed.

40019859.author: पदार्थः
40019859.content: एते these, च and, अन्ये others, च and, बहवः many, राक्षसाः demons, कामरूपिणः form-changing, दिष्ट्या fortunately, त्वया by you, हताः killed, वीराः valiant ones, रघूणाम् of the Raghus, कुलवर्द्धन enhancer of the family.

40019859.author: Translation
40019859.content: Fortunately, O enhancer of the Raghu lineage, these and many other valiant form-changing demons have been slain by you.

40019860.author: पदार्थः
40019860.content: दत्त्वा having given, पुण्याम् sacred, इमाम् this, वीर O hero, सौम्याम् benevolent, अभयदक्षिणाम् gift of fearlessness, दिष्ट्या fortunately, वर्धसि you prosper, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, जयेन by victory, अमित्रकर्शन destroyer of enemies.

40019860.author: Translation
40019860.content: O hero, destroyer of enemies, having granted this sacred and benevolent gift of fearlessness, you fortunately prosper with victory, O Kakutstha.

40019861.author: पदार्थः
40019861.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, तेषाम् their, वचनम् words, ऋषीणाम् of the sages, भावितात्मनाम् of pure souls, विस्मयम् wonder, परमम् great, गत्वा having attained, रामः Rama, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40019861.author: Translation
40019861.content: Having heard the words of those pure-souled sages, Rama, filled with great astonishment, spoke with folded hands.

40019862.author: पदार्थः
40019862.content: भगवन्तः O revered ones, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, रावणम् Ravana, च and, निशाचरम् night-wanderer, अतिक्रम्य having surpassed, महावीर्यौ of great valor, किम् why, प्रशंसथ you praise, रावणिम् Ravana's son.

40019862.author: Translation
40019862.content: O revered ones, having overcome the greatly valorous Kumbhakarna and the night-wandering Ravana, why do you praise Ravana's son (Indrajit)?

40019863.author: पदार्थः
40019863.content: महोदरं Mahodara, प्रहस्तं Prahasta, च and, विरूपाक्षं Virupaksha, च and, राक्षसम् the demon, मत्तोन्मत्तौ Matta and Unmatta, च and, दुर्धर्षौ the invincible ones, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devantaka and Narantaka.

40019863.author: Translation
40019863.content: This shloka lists several powerful demons: Mahodara, Prahasta, Virupaksha, Matta, Unmatta, Devantaka, and Narantaka, all of whom are formidable.

40019864.author: पदार्थः
40019864.content: अतिक्रम्य having overlooked, महावीर्यान् the greatly valorous ones, किं why, प्रशंसथ do you praise, रावणिम् Ravana's son (Indrajit).

40019864.author: Translation
40019864.content: The speaker questions why they are praising Indrajit, having overlooked other greatly valorous warriors.

40019865.author: पदार्थः
40019865.content: अतिकायं Atikaya, त्रिशिरसं Trishiras, धूम्राक्षं Dhumraksha, च and, निशाचरम् the night-ranger (demon), अतिक्रम्य having overlooked, महावीर्यान् the greatly valorous ones, किं why, प्रशंसथ do you praise, रावणिम् Ravana's son (Indrajit).

40019865.author: Translation
40019865.content: The speaker wonders why they praise Indrajit, having disregarded other mighty demons like Atikaya, Trishiras, and Dhumraksha.

40019866.author: पदार्थः
40019866.content: कीदृशो what kind, वै indeed, प्रभावो influence/power, अस्य of him, किं what, बलं strength, कः what, पराक्रमः valor/prowess, केन by what, वा or, कारणेन by reason, एष this one (Indrajit), रावणात् than Ravana, अतिरिच्यते excels/surpasses.

40019866.author: Translation
40019866.content: The speaker asks about Indrajit's power, strength, and prowess, and by what reason he is considered superior to Ravana himself.

40019867.author: पदार्थः
40019867.content: शक्यं possible, यदि if, मया by me, श्रोतुं to hear, न not, खलु indeed, आज्ञापयामि I command, वः you, यदि if, गुह्यं secret, न not, चेत् if, वक्तुं to speak, श्रोतुमिच्छामि I wish to hear, कथ्यताम् let it be told.

40019867.author: Translation
40019867.content: The speaker states that if it is possible for him to hear, he is not commanding them, but if it is not a secret to be spoken, he wishes to hear it, so it should be told.

40019868.author: पदार्थः
40019868.content: शक्रो Indra, अपि even, विजितः conquered, तेन by him (Ravana), कथं how, लब्धवरः obtained boons, च and, सः he (Ravana), कथं how, च and, बलवान् powerful, अयं पुत्रो this son (Ravana), न not, पिता father, तस्य his, रावणः Ravana

40019868.author: Translation
40019868.content: Rama asks how Ravana conquered Indra and obtained boons, and how this powerful son (Ravana) is not like his father (in terms of power or nature).

40019869.author: पदार्थः
40019869.content: कथं how, पितुः than his father, च and, अभ्यधिकः superior, महाहवे in great battle, शक्रस्य of Indra, जेता conqueror, हि indeed, कथं how, सः that, राक्षसः Rakshasa, वराः boons, च and, लब्धाः obtained, कथयस्व tell, मे to me, अद्य today, तत् that, पृच्छतः asking, च and, अस्य this, मुनीन्द्र O chief of sages, सर्वम् all

40019869.author: Translation
40019869.content: Rama further inquires how that Rakshasa (Ravana) became superior to his father, how he conquered Indra in a great battle, and how he obtained boons, requesting the sage to explain everything to him who is asking. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे प्रथमः सर्गः ।। 1 ।। Thus ends the first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
